snippet.title: Monster Behavior and some Environment Tools | Building my Indie MMORPG - Dev-log #2
snippet.description:
This is one of the iterations of my Monster Behavior system (AI).

- This is a dev-build, this is not the final vision of the game. The world/scene itself its just me playing with terrain tools and adding lots of trees, grass and flowers around. No real Environment Art work for now.

- Maybe I'll start recording my voice over the videos, with english subtitles for international audiences.

#mmorpg #indiegame #indiemmo #solodev #unity
